Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

这是 Phase-Gated Compound Sparsity (PACS) 项目的 MVP 验证实验（M1 阶段）。
- 假设：Phase-dependent interaction direction reversal — compound sparsity (attention head pruning + KV cache eviction) 在不同推理阶段（execution/reasoning/transition）展现出不同的交互模式（super- vs sub-additive）
- 这是 P0 bug 修复后的重跑（前一次 mvp_interaction_index_profiling 因 KV eviction mask bug 失败）

- 同时启用了 P1 诊断 dump 验证 phase segmentation

- Pass：任一 phase 对的 Interaction Index (II) bootstrap 95% CI 不重叠
- Pass：任一 phase 对的 II 符号反转（一个 super-additive，一个 sub-additive）
- II = R_both - R_attn - R_kv + 1，其中 R_x = ppl_x / ppl_dense

30% + 50%，2×4×3 = 24 测量点

Bootstrap 1000, ≥20 segments/phase。MATH-500 分层 5×10=50, seed=42
